comments.body:
@rogerbarreto, this comment looks like a copy/paste error.

This use of reflection is also highly undesirable. Seems like the removal of this without a replacement may have been an oversight (I've asked), or maybe Patch is somehow supposed to be used to achieve the same thing. It'd be good to undo this as soon as there's something better.
Indeed, I used the Patch suggestion, thanks!
Consider adding or updating a global.json fixing the SDK to .NET 10.
This workaround can go away once Azure.AI.OpenAI 2.7.0-beta.2 is released.
